text: From 25 Nov 2026 (agreed 24 Nov, replaces n20261121protocol): 5-minute opening-range breakout on stocks in play, long only. Stock in play = under $20, over $0.50, first-five-minute volume (09:30-09:34 NY) at least 5x normal (20-day avg daily volume / 78). Signal = first 5-min candle green. Entry = buy-stop at 5-min high + $0.01; stop = 5-min low - $0.01; out by the close. Every update leads with liquid names running 20%+ from their open, whatever the rule says. Basis: Zarattini & Aziz (2023) stocks-in-play ORB study; AKAN 24 Nov example: 5-min candle 3.28 -> 4.48 green, high 4.49, broke at 09:35, ran to 6.77. Journal backtest 24 Nov: chasing +50% movers -5.7%/trade; buying gappers at the open negative; first pullback to VWAP +2.5-4%/trade over 43 trades (still small sample).
